error_contract.domain_errors: Existing RECAP_* and other domain error codes are preserved.
error_contract.mcp: Tool failures are tools/call results with isError=true; malformed JSON-RPC requests remain protocol errors.

time_contract.calendar: Recap dates retain their recorded time zone and absolute day/period boundaries. Inspect calendar on a day, or calendars[date] on date lists and search results. Legacy days use rule=recorded_bounds with time_zone=null.

tools.description: Get screenshot metadata in the half-open interval [start_ms, end_ms). Results use screenshot_id and captured_at_ms (Unix milliseconds); null capture time means unknown. Returns the earliest matching records up to max_records.

max_records.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 500)

tools.name: get_snapshots_by_time_range

tools.description: Read one screenshot using screenshot_id from another tool. Returns status=found, record with captured_at_ms, and OCR rows with ocr_processed_at_ms. An empty OCR list means no text is currently available for export. Missing screenshots return SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND; privacy rejection returns PRIVACY_REJECTED. Include OCR bounding boxes with include_coords=true.

include_coords.description: Include OCR bounding box coordinates (default false)

screenshot_id.description: screenshot_id returned by another tool; OCR row IDs cannot be used here

tools.name: get_snapshot_details

tools.description: Find words visible on screen using lexical OCR search. Extract distinctive keywords from a question, e.g. 保存路径 or save location. Separate keywords with spaces; a Chinese question is otherwise one long phrase. Fuzzy matching tolerates spelling/OCR errors. Results use screenshot_id for evidence, ocr_id for the text row, captured_at_ms for capture time, and ocr_processed_at_ms for recognition completion; all times are Unix milliseconds.

query.description: Visible words or phrases; use space-separated keywords rather than a full question

tools.name: search_ocr_text

tools.description: Natural language visual search over screenshots using Chinese-CLIP image embeddings. Describe what the screen looks like; use search_ocr_text for visible words. Results use screenshot_id and captured_at_ms (Unix milliseconds). A time filter excludes captures whose time is unknown.
tools.name: search_nl

tools.description: List smart clusters with cluster_id, assignment counts, stored summaries, and explicit Unix-millisecond created_at_ms, updated_at_ms and last_assigned_at_ms fields. Unknown times are null.
tools.name: get_smart_clusters

tools.description: Get smart-cluster screenshots with joined OCR text, screenshot_id, captured_at_ms and assigned_at_ms (Unix milliseconds). Results are paginated and ordered by rerank score.

include_empty_ocr.description: Include snapshots that have no OCR text (default false)

tools.name: get_smart_cluster_ocr_corpus

tools.description: Get the stored AI-generated summary for a smart cluster, if one exists.
tools.name: get_smart_cluster_summary

tools.description: List recorded daily recap dates, newest first, from the most recent 730 non-deleted dates. Each YYYY-MM-DD date retains its saved calendar; inspect calendars[date] for the recorded time zone and UTC boundaries. A listed date may have pending or stale periods; use get_recap_day to read available content. Does not generate recaps.
tools.name: get_recap_days

tools.description: Read a saved daily recap with corrected activities, period overviews and screenshot evidence. Date is YYYY-MM-DD in the returned calendar, whose recorded time zone and day/period boundaries remain fixed. Sources use screenshot_id and captured_at_ms; all instants are Unix milliseconds. Activities are paginated chronologically; follow next_offset or narrow to batch_start_ms. Empty/pending periods do not establish inactivity. Does not generate or modify recap content. Use get_snapshot_details to verify source details.

batch_start_ms.description: Optional period start from a previous response, in Unix milliseconds

tools.name: get_recap_day

tools.description: Search saved, corrected daily recap activities across dates using keywords, local text meaning, or both. Date filters are inclusive saved YYYY-MM-DD labels; inspect calendars[date] for each result's recorded time zone and boundaries. Sources use screenshot_id and captured_at_ms (Unix milliseconds). Verify factual claims with get_snapshot_details. Unlike screenshot semantic search this covers all saved recap dates. Hybrid mode falls back to keywords when the local recap index is incomplete or unavailable; inspect semantic_status. Summaries can omit details, so use OCR or image search when needed. Does not generate recaps or build the index.

include_details.description: Include saved key facts in retrieval

ranking_revision.description: When paging, pass ranking_revision from the previous result. If results changed, restart at offset 0 without this field.

tools.name: search_recaps

tools.description: Create or replace the stored AI-generated title, cluster overview, OCR summary, key points, evidence, and model metadata for a smart cluster.

evidence.description: Optional JSON array/object describing source snapshot evidence

key_points.description: Optional JSON array/object of key points

ocr_summary.description: Integrated summary of OCR information across assigned snapshots

source_hash.description: Optional hash/fingerprint of the source corpus

tools.name: upsert_smart_cluster_summary

tools.description: Delete the stored AI-generated summary for a smart cluster. The smart cluster and its assigned snapshots are preserved.
tools.name: delete_smart_cluster_summary
